## Feature Description

Please provide a clear and concise description of the proposed feature or improvement.

## Motivation

Explain why this feature would be useful for the project.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think the feature could be implemented.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or approaches you considered.

## Area of the Project

Which part of the project would this change affect?

- [ ] Data
- [ ] Exploratory Data Analysis
- [ ] Data Preprocessing
- [ ] Feature Engineering
- [ ] Machine Learning Models
- [ ] Model Evaluation
- [ ] Notebook
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Repository Structure
- [ ] Other

## Additional Information

Add any examples, references, screenshots, or other information that would help explain the proposal.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues for similar requests.
- [ ] This feature is relevant to the purpose of the project.
- [ ] I have clearly described the proposed change.
